summary: F9 Pencairan Marketplace (FinanceSettlementModule) tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed (login, list+summary shape, create unbalanced, dedupe 409, journal rejection when unbalanced, PUT to balance, journal draft with account-level COA 1-131/4-111, idempotent journal, edit blocked once journaled, post -> posted, idempotent post, reconcile by settlement_id + 404, coa-map, DELETE rules, auth guard 401/403, 422 validation, unknown account, 404 detail). Frontend: full UI flow through real login form passed - module renders, KPIs show Rupiah, seeded STL-TEST-001 shows JE-20260815-0001 (posted), create-unbalanced -> live diff Rp -50.000 (red) + warning toast + 'selisih' badge + unverified KPI 0->1, journal on unbalanced -> Indonesian rejection toast, edit prefilled -> other_deductions 50000 -> 'seimbang', journal -> JE-20260715-0001 (draft), post -> (posted), edit/delete buttons disappear after journal, reconcile panel with named gap 'cair_tanpa_pesanan' + close, account filter + refresh work. No React errors in console (only the expected HTTP 400 from the intentional unbalanced-journal test).

issues: KPI 'Total dicairkan' hint uses rows.length (current page, max 50) while the value comes from server-wide summary - the two numbers will disagree once >50 settlements exist.
Table has no pagination controls even though backend returns pagination{total,page,total_pages}; rows beyond page_size=50 are silently unreachable.
Row/action data-testids are built from settlement_id (raw platform string); an id containing spaces/quotes would produce fragile or invalid selectors - consider using r.id.

action_items: Optional (minor): show server-wide count in the net-payout KPI hint instead of rows.length, and add pagination UI for >50 settlements.
critical_code_review_comments: marketing_settlements.py is 840 lines with route + journal-building + reconcile logic in one file; consider splitting journal/reconcile helpers into modules (>700 line guideline).
GET /{sid} is correctly declared last so /reconcile and /coa-map are not shadowed - keep that ordering comment if the file is refactored.
All responses exclude Mongo _id (verified in tests); env vars used correctly on both sides.
seed_data_creation: Created STL-QA-1788373644 (balanced, journaled JE-20260710-0001, posted) via API and STL-UI-1788373763 (balanced, journaled JE-20260715-0001, posted) via UI. Both intentionally left because journaled settlements cannot be deleted. A temporary STL-QA-DEL-* was created and deleted to verify DELETE. STL-TEST-001 untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for this module: /app/backend/tests/test_iter98_settlement.py (uses account c386b3ce-2b85-453a-88a3-b3e5e37277be 'DA Official Shopee', unique STL-QA-<ts> ids each run; leaves one journaled settlement per run - unavoidable since journaled docs cannot be deleted). Settlement list now has 3+ posted rows; unverified_count should be 0 at rest.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. The single console 400 is the deliberate 'journal on unbalanced settlement' assertion and is surfaced to the user as a proper toast.
